questions.question: What is the name of the First Truth in this passage?
questions.answer: It is the Truth of Opening.

questions.question: What does “opening” mean here?
questions.answer: It means bringing many different forms out from one simple thing.

questions.question: How many different forms does the passage say can be brought forth from one simple substance?
questions.answer: Very many forms.

questions.question: In what kind of places does this opening happen?
questions.answer: It happens everywhere.

questions.question: How fast does the passage describe this opening?
questions.answer: It happens at once.

questions.question: Which Divine Name is shown in this truth?
questions.answer: The Name of Opener.

questions.question: What example from the garden of the universe is given first?
questions.answer: Flowers.

questions.question: What does each being receive through this opening?
questions.answer: Each one gets its own ordered shape and special identity.

questions.question: What big group on earth is also said to have its own forms?
questions.answer: The many kinds of living creatures on earth.

questions.question: About how many kinds of living things are mentioned?
questions.answer: About four hundred thousand kinds.

questions.question: How are the forms of these living things described?
questions.answer: They are balanced, beautiful, and different from one another.

questions.question: Where does the passage say people are shaped before birth?
questions.answer: In their mothers’ wombs.

questions.question: How many darknesses are mentioned for the womb?
questions.answer: Three.

questions.question: According to the verses, who makes the forms in the womb as He wills?
questions.answer: Allah.

questions.question: What two school subjects are named as giving witness about forms in living things?
questions.answer: Botany and biology.

questions.question: According to the passage, could just anyone do this all-reaching work of making forms?
questions.answer: No. Only Allah can do it.

questions.question: What qualities are needed for this work of making forms?
questions.answer: Wisdom, care, and power that reaches all things.

questions.question: Why is this truth a strong proof that Allah is One?
questions.answer: Because the same perfect work is done for all people and animals without mistakes or mix-ups.

questions.question: What does the passage say is missing in this making of forms?
questions.answer: Error, confusion, and mistake.

questions.question: Why is there no room for partners with Allah in this work?
questions.answer: Because this work covers and holds all things together.

questions.question: What truth does the traveler see in this part?
questions.answer: He sees the First Truth, the Truth of Opening.

questions.question: What comes out from a single simple substance in this truth?
questions.answer: Many different separate forms come out.

questions.question: Are these forms all the same or different?
questions.answer: They are different.

questions.question: Does the passage describe this work as one act or many unconnected acts?
questions.answer: It describes it as one act.

questions.question: What does the example of flowers help us understand?
questions.answer: It helps us see that Allah brings many living things into beautiful forms.

questions.question: What two things does each being get besides life in the flower example?
questions.answer: An orderly shape and its own identity.

questions.question: What garden is spoken of when the passage talks about living species on earth?
questions.answer: The garden of the earth.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the forms of the many species on earth?
questions.answer: Each kind has its own neat and decorated form.

questions.question: What human beginning is used as a sign of Allah’s power?
questions.answer: A baby being formed in the womb.

questions.question: What does the verse remind people after speaking about creation in the womb?
questions.answer: That Allah is their Sustainer and only He is God.

questions.question: What does the passage say is hidden from Allah?
questions.answer: Nothing is hidden from Him.

questions.question: Where is nothing hidden from Allah?
questions.answer: Not on earth and not in the sky.

questions.question: Who shapes people in the womb?
questions.answer: Allah shapes them.

questions.question: What do the verses show is a very strong sign of Allah’s oneness?
questions.answer: The making and opening of forms.

questions.question: Which two fields of study are said to support this truth by deep research?
questions.answer: Botany and biology.

questions.question: Why can no weak being do this work?
questions.answer: Because it needs endless power and full knowledge and care.

questions.question: Who alone has the power to manage such a huge work?
questions.answer: The One who runs the whole universe.

questions.question: How are human and animal forms across the earth made in this passage?
questions.answer: With the same power, wisdom, and art.

questions.question: What does the passage say about mistakes in this process?
questions.answer: There are no mistakes and no confusion.

questions.question: What idea about Allah is proved when one power reaches all things?
questions.answer: It proves His unity.

questions.question: What is the heading of this truth?
questions.answer: The Truth of Opening.

questions.question: What is being “opened” in this passage?
questions.answer: The forms of living things.

questions.question: From what does the passage say many forms can come?
questions.answer: From one simple substance.

questions.question: How does the passage show that Allah’s work is both huge and easy for Him?
questions.answer: It says many forms appear together, everywhere, and right away.

questions.question: What sign in nature is used first to picture this truth?
questions.answer: Flowers in a garden.

questions.question: What does Allah give each flower-like being?
questions.answer: Its own well-made form and identity.

questions.question: Does the passage speak only about a few living things or many species?
questions.answer: It speaks about many species.

questions.question: About how many species are named?
questions.answer: About four hundred thousand.

questions.question: What words show that each species is carefully made?
questions.answer: Their forms are balanced, decorated, and distinct.

questions.question: Before a baby is born, where is Allah shaping it?
questions.answer: In the mother’s womb.

questions.question: What number of darknesses is mentioned?
questions.answer: Three.

questions.question: What can people learn about Allah from this making in the womb?
questions.answer: They can learn that He is the only true God and the Lord.

questions.question: What do the verses say about Allah’s knowledge?
questions.answer: He knows everything, and nothing is hidden from Him.

questions.question: Which sciences are called as witnesses in this passage?
questions.answer: Botany and biology.

questions.question: What do these sciences help show?
questions.answer: They help show the wide and skillful making of forms.

questions.question: Why must the maker of these forms be One?
questions.answer: Because the work reaches all living things in a complete way.

questions.question: What three qualities does this work need all the time?
questions.answer: Wisdom, attention, and comprehensiveness.

questions.question: Where can such all-reaching power be found, according to the passage?
questions.answer: Only in the One who controls the whole cosmos.

questions.question: Why is making forms a proof against the idea of many gods?
questions.answer: Because one complete order leaves no place for partners.

questions.question: What does the traveler see after this truth ends?
questions.answer: He sees the Second Truth.

questions.question: What main idea is taught in this passage?
questions.answer: Allah shows His oneness by giving forms to all living things.

questions.question: What special name is connected to this work?
questions.answer: The Name of Opener.

questions.question: What does the passage say happens from one simple starting point?
questions.answer: Many different forms are brought out.

questions.question: Does this work happen slowly one by one in only one place, or broadly all at once?
questions.answer: It happens broadly all at once.

questions.question: What picture from nature helps explain this?
questions.answer: A garden full of flowers.

questions.question: What does each created being have that shows care and order?
questions.answer: Its own shape and identity.

questions.question: What large number of species is mentioned on earth?
questions.answer: Four hundred thousand species.

questions.question: How are the forms of these species described in simple words?
questions.answer: They are even, pretty, and different.

questions.question: What place inside the mother is named in the verses?
questions.answer: The womb.

questions.question: What does “creation after creation” help us understand?
questions.answer: That Allah makes people in stages.

questions.question: How many darknesses are mentioned around the baby in the womb?
questions.answer: Three.

questions.question: What do the verses teach about who owns rule and power?
questions.answer: Allah does.

questions.question: What do the verses teach about other gods besides Allah?
questions.answer: There are no other gods.

questions.question: What two study areas are mentioned as supporting this truth?
questions.answer: Botany and biology.

questions.question: Why is the work of forming living things too great for anything other than Allah?
questions.answer: Because it needs perfect wisdom, care, and endless power over all things.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the forms of all people and animals across the earth?
questions.answer: They are made with the same power, wisdom, and art.

questions.question: Are these forms made with mix-ups and mistakes?
questions.answer: No, they are made without them.

questions.question: What does it mean that this work “comprehends” all things?
questions.answer: It means the work covers all of them together.

questions.question: How does that all-covering work point to unity?
questions.answer: It shows one Lord is doing it all.

questions.question: What kind of proof of Allah’s unity is this called?
questions.answer: A very strong proof.

questions.question: What truth is introduced at the start of the marked passage?
questions.answer: The Truth of Opening.

questions.question: What is one simple way to say “opening” here?
questions.answer: It means giving shape and form.

questions.question: What surprising thing happens from one plain substance?
questions.answer: Many kinds of forms come from it.

questions.question: How does the passage describe when and where this happens?
questions.answer: It happens together, everywhere, and in an instant.

questions.question: Through which Name of Allah does this happen?
questions.answer: Through the Name of Opener.

questions.question: What example from the universe is used before talking about earth’s species?
questions.answer: The opening of flowers.

questions.question: What two features are given to each being in that example?
questions.answer: A proper form and a unique identity.

questions.question: What number is given for the species of living things on earth?
questions.answer: Four hundred thousand.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the look of these species?
questions.answer: Each one has its own balanced and adorned form.

questions.question: What human place of growth is mentioned in the Qur’an verses here?
questions.answer: The mother’s womb.

questions.question: What does the passage say Allah does in the womb?
questions.answer: He forms people as He wills.

questions.question: What is hidden from Allah according to the verses?
questions.answer: Nothing.

questions.question: What is called one of the strongest signs of Allah’s oneness?
questions.answer: The opening up of forms.

questions.question: What branches of science are mentioned to support this point?
questions.answer: Botany and biology.

questions.question: What do these studies show about the making of forms?
questions.answer: They show great skill and a reach over many things.

questions.question: Why would this work require infinite power?
questions.answer: Because it must always be done with wisdom and care in everything.

questions.question: Who alone can have that kind of power?
questions.answer: The One who directs the whole universe.

questions.question: How are human forms in the womb described?
questions.answer: They are made separately, evenly, clearly, and in order.

questions.question: What problems are absent from this creation?
questions.answer: Wrongness, confusion, and mistakes are absent.

questions.question: Why does such complete making show Allah has no partners?
questions.answer: Because a work that includes all things belongs to one Lord.

questions.question: What is the first truth called in this passage?
questions.answer: It is called the Truth of Opening.

questions.question: What does this truth focus on in created things?
questions.answer: It focuses on their forms being brought out.

questions.question: From how many simple substances does the passage begin its explanation?
questions.answer: From a single simple substance.

questions.question: What comes from that one simple source?
questions.answer: Countless different forms.

questions.question: How united is this action of creating forms described to be?
questions.answer: It is described as a single deed.

questions.question: What Name of Allah appears in this truth?
questions.answer: The Name of Opener.

questions.question: What example from a garden is used to help us picture this truth?
questions.answer: Flowers are used.

questions.question: Besides flowers, what big living world is spoken about next?
questions.answer: The living creatures on earth.

questions.question: How many species of animate beings are mentioned?
questions.answer: Four hundred thousand species.

questions.question: What does each species receive?
questions.answer: Its own even, decorated, and separate form.

questions.question: What place do the verses mention for the making of human forms?
questions.answer: The mothers’ wombs.

questions.question: What number is used for the darknesses there?
questions.answer: Three.

questions.question: What do the verses say about Allah’s power to shape people?
questions.answer: He shapes them however He wills.

questions.question: What do the verses say about Allah’s knowledge of hidden things?
questions.answer: Nothing in earth or heaven is hidden from Him.

questions.question: Which sciences are mentioned as giving evidence here?
questions.answer: Botany and biology.

questions.question: What do they testify about the opening of forms?
questions.answer: They testify that it is vast and full of art.

questions.question: Why can only one all-powerful Creator do this deed?
questions.answer: Because it needs complete wisdom, attention, and power over everything.

questions.question: What larger truth does the making of all people and animals point to?
questions.answer: It points to Allah’s unity.

questions.question: What is the reason given that partners cannot share in this work?
questions.answer: Because the work includes and surrounds all things.

questions.question: At the end of this passage, what does the traveler go on to see?
questions.answer: He goes on to see the Second Truth.
